HIKMICRO AD21 Acoustic Leak Detector

SKU: HM-AP21-AD21
Contact Us For Pricing $0.00
Contact Us For Pricing
Need more info? Call us +61 8 9335 1718
Price Match International Orders Tax Removed

  • Description
  • Shipping
  • Delivery & Returns

The HIKMICRO Acoustic Leak Detector AD21 is a high-performance device designed for technicians and  plumbers to find leaks in plumbing, water service, and residential or commercial properties. The device has four ranges of selectable digital bandpass filters, and the amplification is up to 80 dB. The filtration and amplification of the sound frequencies can help you locate the leakage points accurately. It can be widely used with the handheld sensor and pick-up sensor correspondingly. Furthermore, it can detect ignored leaks, reducing resource waste and property loss.

 Key Features

  • Supports four ranges of selectable digital bandpass filters
  • Frequency Range 150Hz-7500Hz
  • 1024 × 600 Resolution, 7"LCD Touch Screen
  • Up to 11 hours continuous running
